docs.title: 🖖 Welcome to Starfleet Technology Documentation
docs.text:
"To boldly code where no one has coded before..."

Welcome to the comprehensive documentation hub for Starfleet Technology — a passionate, fan-driven open source initiative bringing Star Trek to life through code!

docs.title: 🛸 Our Mission
docs.text:
We're building amazing Star Trek-inspired applications and tools:

  • 🎲 Tabletop Companions — RPG enhancement tools
  • ⭐ Strategy Simulators — Fleet command experiences
  • 🚀 Bridge Operations — Immersive starship simulations
  • 💫 Interactive Portals — Trek web applications

docs.title: 📖 Documentation Structure
docs.text: Our documentation follows the Diátaxis framework for clear, organized content:

docs.title: 🎯 Tutorials
docs.text:
Learning-oriented • Acquisition of skills

Step-by-step lessons to get you started. Perfect for newcomers who want to learn by doing.

docs.title: 🔧 How-to Guides
docs.text:
Problem-oriented • Application of skills

Practical solutions to specific problems. For when you know what you want to achieve.

docs.title: 📚 Reference
docs.text:
Information-oriented • Application of skills

Technical specifications, API documentation, and detailed information. For when you need precise details.

docs.title: 💡 Explanation
docs.text:
Understanding-oriented • Acquisition of skills

Background concepts, design decisions, and the "why" behind our projects. For deeper understanding.

docs.title: 🚀 Mission Status
docs.text:
Just beginning our journey — nothing built yet, but every great starship starts with a blueprint!

Our documentation will grow as we develop our projects. Check back regularly for updates.

docs.title: 🤝 Join Our Crew
docs.text:
All contributors welcome — developers, designers, writers, and Trek enthusiasts with ideas!

  • 📝 Documentation: Help improve these docs
  • 💻 Development: Build amazing Trek tools
  • 🎨 Design: Create beautiful interfaces
  • 💡 Ideas: Share your vision for Trek technology
